cards.titulo: Rio New Year's Eve: what it costs
cards.sub: Copacabana on Dec 31: free on the sand, 12 minutes of fireworks

cards.nota: Djavan and Pedro Sampaio are on the main stage, plus a drone show over the sea.
Figures from the 2025/26 plan: an online-only metro pass with set departure times. The 2026/27 plan comes out in December, so check MetrôRio before you go.

itens: Locals dress in white for luck, and many jump 7 waves at midnight.
Phone in a front pocket, one card, a little cash. No glass on the sand.
Phone networks jam at midnight. Use a numbered lifeguard post.
Leme and the Posto 6 end are less packed than the middle.

cards.texto: A free Christmas samba show on the Copacabana main stage, five nights before New Year.
cards.dica: Rio fills up for New Year. Staying near a metro station makes the night much easier.

cards.titulo: Tipping in Brazil: who and how much
cards.sub: Spoiler: the 10% on your bill is already the tip, and it's optional

cards.texto: That's the tip, already on the bill. By law (Lei 13.419/2017) it's optional, but most people pay it when service was good.
cards.dica: If the 10% is on the bill, you don't need to leave more. Some upscale places charge 12–15%.

cards.nota: Housekeeping R$ 5–10 ≈ US$ 1–2. Nobody expects US-style 20%.

itens: That's the 10%. If service was bad, you can ask to take it off.
The "couvert artístico" is only owed if it was announced first, on a sign or the menu.
Read the total on the screen before you tap.
Ask the staff to fix it and keep the bill.

alt: Cover: Tipping in Brazil, who and how much
Restaurants: the 10% service line on the bill is the tip, optional by law; some places charge 12 to 15%
Typical tips: round up taxis, R$ 5 a bag for porters, R$ 5 to 10 a day for housekeeping, up to 10% for a great guide, 10% at bars with table service
Four checks before paying: find the service line, live music charge only if announced, check the card machine, ask staff to fix errors

cards.titulo: Christmas in Gramado: what it costs
cards.sub: Natal Luz runs until Jan 17, 2027, and lots of it is free

cards.nota: The lighting show is on the Palácio dos Festivais facade; the village is at Praça das Etnias. Times vary, check the official program.
cards.rodape: Sources: Melhores Destinos, Viaje pra Gramado

cards.nota: Half-price (meia) tickets exist for some groups. Prices change by date and seat: buy from sellers authorized by GramadoTur.

cards.texto: The 41st edition is on now: 88 days of lights, parades and shows in the mountains of southern Brazil.
cards.dica: The Grande Desfile runs Wed, Fri and Sun; the lake show Thu and Sat, both at 8 pm. Pick your shows, then book the hotel.
